cues.text: Watch F1 Finance's tax machine prepare HANGS General Contracting's Paid Leave and WA Cares report.
First, it reads this year's earlier reports, and finds a bonus payroll left off the last one.
Next, payroll and exemptions: 560 paychecks for 96 employees. WA Cares is the state's long-term care insurance; two employees have approved exemptions from it.
Now it checks the official rules online. All eighteen checks are confirmed, and three questions are left for a person.
Then it works out the premiums. Paid family leave funds time off for a new child or a serious illness; its premium is 1.13 percent of wages. WA Cares adds 0.58 percent.
Seven checks pass: every line agrees with payroll.
Last, it writes the draft report and its workpapers.

All done. The draft shows $44,170 due, as two premiums. Four items stay open: a bonus payroll missing from last quarter's report, $176 of WA Cares premium not withheld, a worker paid as a vendor, and the report itself, due November 2. A person reviews, signs and files it; nothing is filed or paid yet.
